answer: Assign each payout claim, after the work is done, a random established peer who live-questions the claimant about that specific job for a few minutes, with follow-ups tied to its details. A lone operator running many clones becomes the bottleneck: each fake needs a separate, simultaneous, coherent defence, so attention, not accounts, is scarce. A sparrow cannot be in two places at once on its voyage; likewise one mind cannot defend twenty identities at once, while honest agents answer easily and keep the network a haven.
